name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: All landholding farmer families with cultivable land subject to exclusion criteria
benefits: Direct income support of ₹6,000 per year in three equal installments of ₹2,000 directly into bank accounts via DBT.
eligibility_criteria: Must own cultivable agricultural land in their name
Valid Aadhaar card linked with bank account
e-KYC completed on the official portal
Institutional landholders and high-income/tax-paying individuals are excluded
documents_required: Bank passbook details with IFSC code
Active mobile number linked to Aadhaar

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: All farmers growing notified crops in notified areas including sharecroppers and tenant farmers
benefits: Comprehensive crop insurance coverage against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest. Low uniform premium: 2% for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops, with remaining subsidized by govt.
eligibility_criteria: Farmers having an insurable interest in notified crops in notified areas
Enrolled through bank (for loanee farmers) or National Crop Insurance Portal (for non-loanee farmers) before cutoff date

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Finance & Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
target_beneficiaries: Owner cultivators, tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and SHGs of farmers, fisheries, and animal husbandry
benefits: Timely short-term credit for cultivation expenses, post-harvest expenses, produce marketing, and maintenance of farm assets at a subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive).
eligibility_criteria: All farmers—individuals/joint borrowers who are owner cultivators
Tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers
Self Help Groups (SHGs) or Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers
documents_required: Land records verified by revenue authority

name: Soil Health Card Scheme (SHC)
ministry: Department of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: All farmers across India holding agricultural land
benefits: Provides printed soil test reports with 12 crucial parameters (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and customized dosage recommendations for fertilizers and micronutrients.
eligibility_criteria: All farmers holding agricultural land whose soil samples are collected by the state agriculture department or participating KVK
documents_required: Land survey number and location coordinates

name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (PMKSY) - Per Drop More Crop
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Govt of India
target_beneficiaries: Small, marginal, and general farmers adopting micro-irrigation
benefits: Subsidies ranging from 45% to 55% of the unit cost for installing Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems to maximize water use efficiency.
eligibility_criteria: Farmer having cultivable land with an assured water source (borewell, open well, or farm pond)
Preference given to small and marginal farmers

name: Raitha Siri Scheme (Karnataka)
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka
target_beneficiaries: Farmers cultivating minor millets (Ragi, Jowar, Bajra, Foxtail millet, etc.) in Karnataka
benefits: Direct financial assistance of ₹10,000 per hectare (up to a maximum of 2 hectares) transferred to farmers' bank accounts through DBT for cultivating millets.
eligibility_criteria: Must be a resident farmer of Karnataka
Land registered in Karnataka FRUITS (Farmer Registration and Unified Beneficiary Information System) database
Cultivating designated millet crops verified via Crop Survey application

name: UP Kisan Uday Yojana & Crop Loan Waiver Schemes
ministry: Department of Agriculture, Government of Uttar Pradesh
target_beneficiaries: Small and marginal farmers of Uttar Pradesh
benefits: Subsidized solar pump installations for irrigation and periodic institutional crop loan relief assistance.
eligibility_criteria: Permanent resident farmer of Uttar Pradesh
Land ownership up to 2 hectares for marginal category
